blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House Speaker Faustino G. Dy III on Friday joined President FerdinandR. Marcos Jr. in celebrating the Philippine Coast Guard’s (PCG) 125th founding anniversary, as the president reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to strengthening the agency’s capabilities amid growing maritime challenges. Dy attended the anniversary celebration at the Eva Macapagal Super Terminal in Manila’s South Harbor alongside Department of Transportation Acting Secretary Giovanni Lopez, Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla, and PCG Commandant Admiral Ronnie Gil Gavan. The celebration, with the theme “One Sea, One Mission, One Legacy: 125 Years of Guarding the Nation’s Maritime Future,” included the presentation […]...
